## 201 - 209

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00201">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />201 Flow time too high for hourly record</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00201">

This exception is generated for a gas or liquid orifice meter with hourly data resolution, when the flow time on an imported record is larger than the Pct. Flow in 1 Hour value set in [System Configuration](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration%20-%20General%20Tab.md#ExceptionValues). This exception is resolved for a no-flow record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00202">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />202 Flow time too high for daily record</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00202">

This exception is generated for a gas or liquid orifice meter with daily data resolution when the flow time on an imported record is larger than the Pct. Flow in 1 Day value set in [System Configuration](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration%20-%20General%20Tab.md#ExceptionValues). This exception is resolved for a no-flow record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00203">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />203 Warning - Water vapor correction is applied to dehydrated gas (EFM)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00203">

This exception is generated when Water Vapor Correction Factor is set to be used in the Meter Characteristics; the Dehydrated Gas field is also set to "Yes"; and at least one of the Water Vapor Technique and the Water Vapor Method fields is null. This exception is generated upon saving such Characteristic record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00204">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />204 Warning - Water vapor correction is applied to dehydrated gas (FC)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00204">

This exception is generated when Water Vapor Correction Factor is set to be used in the Meter Characteristics; the Dehydrated Gas field is also set to "Yes"; and neither of the Water Vapor Technique and the Water Vapor Method fields is not null. This exception is generated upon saving such Characteristic record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00205">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />205 Differential = 0; volume = 0; flow time &gt; 0</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00205">

This exception is generated upon import of gas orifice or gas cone meter data, for periodic records that have differential pressure of 0 or less, volume of 0, and flow time (or flow %) that is non-null and greater than 0. This exception is resolved when the periodic record is saved with a flow time of 0, including a calculated flow time of 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00206">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />206 Differential = 0; volume = 0; flow time not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00206">

This exception is generated upon import of gas orifice or gas cone meter data, for periodic records that have 0 differential pressure, 0 volume, and null flow time (or flow %). This exception is resolved when the periodic record is saved with a flow time of 0, including a calculated flow time of 0. As FLOWCAL calculates flow time of 0 upon import of differential pressure and volume of 0, this exception is resolved when the periodic record is recalculated after import. This exception also gets resolved during the import process (status “RD”) if Flowing Parameters validations are enabled.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00207">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />207 Prove overdue (operational time allowed between proves exceeded)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00207">

This exception is generated on periodic records if the time elapsed between the last prove date and the periodic record effective date is greater than the operational limit. When this validation is enabled, there must be manual prove adjustments applied to batches. To enable this validation, an operational limit for Maximum Time Between Proves must be configured for the meter on Contractual Limits. The operational limit configuration must be effective for the date of data being validated.

For example, liquid meter PROVE_METER has two batches in August 2017 with effective dates 8/1/2017 7:00:00 and 8/15/2017 7:00:00. There is a contractual limit record for this meter with effective dates 1/1/2017 7:00:00-1/1/2018 7:00:00. On the contractual limit record, the operational limit for Maximum Time Between Proves is set to 15 (days). A prove adjustment is made to the 8/1/2017 batch with the prove date of 8/3/2017 09:17:44. Then, periodic records with effective date greater than 8/18/2017 9:17:44 are more than 15 days past the prove date. Hence exception 207 is generated for all periodic records starting on 8/18/2017 10:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00208">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />208 Prove overdue (contractual time allowed between proves exceeded)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00208">

This exception is generated on periodic records if the time elapsed between the last prove date and the periodic record effective date is greater than the contractual limit. When this validation is enabled, there must be manual prove adjustments applied to batches. To enable this validation, a contractual limit for Maximum Time Between Proves must be configured for the meter on Contractual Limits. The contractual limit configuration must be effective for the date of data being validated.

For example, liquid meter PROVE_METER has two batches in August 2017 with effective dates 8/1/2017 7:00:00 and 8/15/2017 7:00:00. There is a contractual limit record for this meter with effective dates 1/1/2017 7:00:00-1/1/2018 7:00:00. On the contractual limit record, the contractual limit for Maximum Time Between Proves is set to 15 (days). A prove adjustment is made to the 8/1/2017 batch with the prove date of 8/3/2017 09:17:44. Then, periodic records with effective date greater than 8/18/2017 9:17:44 are more than 15 days past the prove date. Hence exception 208 is generated for all periodic records starting on 8/18/2017 10:00:00.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00209">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />209 Prove overdue (operational volume allowed between proves exceeded)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00209">

This exception is generated on periodic records if the volume accumulated since the prior prove until the periodic record effective date is greater than the operational limit. When this validation is enabled, there must be manual prove adjustments for batches. To enable this validation, an operational limit for Accumulated Vol Between Proves must be configured for the meter on Contractual Limits. The operational limit configuration must be effective for the date of data being validated. Totalizer Digits in the meter characteristics must be specified.

The accumulated volume for the periodic record since the prior prove on the meter is calculated as (Indicated Volume Start Index for the periodic record - Current Index for the prove). If IV start index is less than the current index, the calculation takes Totalizer Digits into account for index rollover calculations.

For example, liquid meter PROVE_METER has Totalizer Digits of 5. There are 2 batches in August 2017 with effective dates 8/1/2017 7:00:00 and 8/15/2017 7:00:00. There is a contractual limit record for this meter with effective dates 1/1/2017 7:00:00-1/1/2018 7:00:00. On the contractual limit record, the operational limit for Accumulated Vol Between Proves is set to 8000.

A prove adjustment is made to the 8/1/2017 batch with the prove date of 8/1/2017 09:17:44 and current index of 305. Periodic record at 8/14/2017 17:00:00 has an Indicated Volume Start Index of 8424. The accumulated volume since prior prove for the periodic record is then calculated as 8424 – 305 = 8115. This is greater than the operational limit of 8000, so exception 209 is generated for the periodic record.

Another prove adjustment is made to the 8/15/2017 batch with the prove date of 8/15/2017 8:44:21 and current index of 2503. Periodic record at 8/28/2017 23:00:00 has an Indicated Volume Start Index of 1229. The current index is smaller than the IV start index, so Totalizer Digits of 5 is used for the accumulated volume calculation which yields 10000 + 1229 - 2503 = 8726. This is greater than the operational limit of 8000, so exception 209 is generated for the periodic record.

</div>

</div>
